verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail documents its own Zapier integration that connects 'your mail' to 5000+ apps, which the story accepts as a minimum substitute for webhooks. However, no specific trigger events such as new mail arrived or scan completed are documented. The API is gated behind a contact-to-request process, with no public reference and no documented webhook registration. Email alerts are not programmatic callbacks. Missing for 10: documented registrable webhooks, named Zapier triggers for new-mail and scan-complete events, public API/event documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I get webhooks (or at least Zapier triggers) when new mail arrives or a scan completes, so downstream automation starts without polling

citations.quote: With Zapier, you can connect your mail to 5000+ apps.
